answer: The harbor lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the reef of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
